criteria.statement: No answer contains text the server did not render, or any text the case forbids.
criteria.denominator: Every held-out case, live and replay. Reads the count of cases.

criteria.statement: Every citation resolves against the bound run, and matches the rendered claims exactly.
criteria.denominator: Held-out cases that terminated as answered.

criteria.statement: Every response carries the fixture's labelled output nature.
criteria.denominator: Every held-out case, live and replay.

criteria.statement: The model answers no case labelled as a non-answer that the deterministic route gets right.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out cases, paired with route_following on the same cases.

criteria.statement: Required tools ran, and no forbidden tool ran.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out cases expecting an answer, where a model turn happened. A provider failure counts as wrong.

criteria.statement: No citation, answer, or trace refers to another run.
criteria.denominator: Every held-out case, live and replay.

criteria.statement: Nothing outside the registry ever ran.
criteria.denominator: Every tool call in the held-out split.

criteria.statement: No live model named a tool outside the registry.
criteria.denominator: Every tool call by a live model. Replay cases are excluded, because they attempt this on purpose.

criteria.statement: Provider failures plus invalid outputs stay at or below 5%.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out questions that reached a model, counted once per question.

criteria.statement: End-to-end p95 stays at or below 8 seconds. PROVISIONAL: the roadmap ties this to M1 latency, which has not been measured, and a cold run also pays first-use schema compilation.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out questions that reached a model. First-use and repeat-schema latency are reported apart.

criteria.statement: PROPOSED ADDITION. The model does not abstain on a case the deterministic route answers correctly. Without this, a model that abstains on everything passes.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out cases, paired with route_following on the same cases.

criteria.statement: PROPOSED ADDITION. Claim selection is at or above 80%, the floor that shows the model answers what it is asked.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out cases expecting an answer, including those the router stops.

criteria.statement: PROPOSED ADDITION. The model corrects at least half of the deterministic route's false answers. Without this, nothing shows the model adds value.
criteria.denominator: Live held-out cases where route_following gives a false answer.
